name: How can I tell if my window weatherstripping needs to be replaced?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my window weatherstripping needs to be replaced?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs that your window weatherstripping needs replacement include noticeable drafts, higher energy bills, visible cracks, gaps, or deterioration of the material. You might also find moisture stains around the windows, feel cold air leaking in during winter, or observe rattling sashes. A simple test is to close the window on a piece of paper; if you can easily pull it out, the seal is likely compromised.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for drafts, higher energy bills, visible damage, or moisture around windows. A paper test can confirm if the seal is faulty.
